shopify_community_learning.purpose: Help merchants and identify repeated consequential inventory needs that existing solutions demonstrably leave unresolved.
process: Record the actual merchant need with source quotes through community-record
Separate vendor self-promotion from merchant recommendations
Keep acquisition potential separate from learning value
Answer the question with practical value before any relevant disclosed product mention
Leave vendor-heavy threads learning-only when no useful answer is available
Use deterministic ten-thread batches and interpret new evidence in the existing daily review
shopify_community_learning.output: Auditable discussion records, evolving problem categories, deduplicated competitor appearances, useful-answer decisions and evidence-linked positioning/product hypotheses.
shopify_community_learning.success_signal: Useful merchant interactions, qualified opportunities or evidence that improves prospect selection, positioning or product priorities.
failure_conditions: Vendor claims mistaken for merchant demand
shopify_community_learning.cost_expectation: Existing two-search/four-read/five-minute discovery budget; no extra models or paid APIs; deterministic persistence and ten-thread aggregates.
